summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares an ESLint plugin purpose but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, and then executes a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle beginning `// @bun @bun-cjs` with mangled identifiers and an opaque string/opcode constant table. The advertised ESLint rule lives in a small `dist/index.js` and does not require a second language runtime. Running the payload under Bun means it cannot be inspected by Node-based tooling and no source form of the bundle is shipped. The preinstall path gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on every `npm install`, using the Bun runtime as a wrapper to execute an obfuscated payload wholly unrelated to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
